decision: Do not replace APK weights: float-head INT8 is faster but loses field-val quality; full-head INT8 rejected.
limitations: Validation only; test not evaluated. Existing pilot has missing training classes.
Timing uses random input; excludes camera, preprocessing, decoding and rendering.
Whole process PSS includes framework/test resources and is not model-only memory.
One USB-powered Redmi run in fixed model order; no sustained thermal or energy conclusion.
Application YOLO26s has a different class set; this timing comparison does not compare accuracy.
Calibration reports are prior-session evidence; quantization was not rerun in this continuation.
